// usage: Copy to .mcp.json (untracked) and set GITHUB_MCP_TOKEN and CONTEXT7_API_KEY in your environment; Claude Code expands ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} in args. GITHUB_MCP_URL defaults to GitHub's hosted server; point it at a self-hosted github-mcp-server if you run one. mcp-compressor is fetched on demand via uvx (needs `uv` on PATH).
// cli-syntax: mcp-compressor 0.31.4 requires `--compression` (not --compression-level), `-H` (not --header), and a `--` separator before the backend URL/args. Backends with no real Authorization header also need a placeholder `-H Authorization=Bearer unused`, or mcp-compressor auto-attempts OAuth discovery and fails.
